1234550002515.sourceDescription:
Bring the enchanting beauty of a snowy winter forest into your home with the 152cm Slim Snow Flocked Christmas Tree. Featuring an elegant alpine-inspired silhouette and realistic snow-dusted branches, this artificial Christmas tree creates a beautiful festive centrepiece while taking up less floor space.

Realistic Snow-Flocked Appearance

Designed with high-quality PVC needles and a delicate snow-flocked finish, this tree recreates the natural charm of a snow-covered alpine Christmas tree. Its realistic branches provide an attractive display for baubles, hanging ornaments, fairy lights and other festive decorations.

Slim and Space-Saving Design

The elegant slim profile makes this Christmas tree ideal for smaller rooms, apartments, hallways and corners. It offers a stylish festive display without occupying excessive floor space, making it a practical choice for homes with limited room.

Durable PVC Construction

Made with durable PVC materials, the branches create a natural-looking appearance while providing space to display your favourite Christmas decorations. Designed for seasonal use, this reusable artificial tree can be enjoyed year after year.

Easy Assembly and Storage

The convenient branch design allows the branches to fan out during setup, helping you create your desired tree shape. After the festive season, the tree can be disassembled and stored away ready for next Christmas.

Sturdy Support Stand

Supplied with a sturdy stand designed to provide reliable support and stability, helping keep your Christmas tree securely positioned throughout the festive season.

Product Specifications:

Product Type: Artificial Christmas Tree

Height: 152cm

Design: Slim Alpine

Finish: Snow Flocked

Material: PVC Needles

Style: Space-Saving

Assembly: Required

152CM SLIM CHRISTMAS TREE – Standing 152cm tall, this elegant artificial tree creates an eye-catching festive display while maintaining a narrow profile suitable for different indoor spaces.
SPACE-SAVING ALPINE STYLE – The slim silhouette is ideal for apartments, smaller rooms, hallways and corners, allowing you to enjoy Christmas decorations without taking up too much floor space.
REALISTIC PVC BRANCHES – Made with PVC needles designed to provide a natural-looking appearance and create an attractive backdrop for Christmas baubles, ornaments, tinsel and decorative lights.
DURABLE REUSABLE CONSTRUCTION – Designed for seasonal use, this artificial Christmas tree offers a practical decorating solution that can be assembled and enjoyed for future Christmas celebrations.
EASY ASSEMBLY – Features branches that fan out for convenient setup, allowing you to arrange the tree and create an attractive festive shape with ease.
STURDY SUPPORT STAND – Includes a sturdy stand designed to provide reliable support and help keep the Christmas tree securely positioned.
CONVENIENT STORAGE – Can be disassembled after the festive season and packed away for convenient storage, ready to use again next year.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

What is oxo-biodegradable plastic?
Oxo-biodegradable plastic is ordinary plastic to which small amounts of metal salts (a prodegradant additive) has been added during the manufacturing process. The resulting plastic is then made into products like carrier bags, produce or courier bags, straws and other short-life/single-use items. The big difference between oxo-biodegradable and ordinary plastic is that if oxo-biodegradable plastic escapes collection and ends up in the open environment as litter, it will degrade and biodegrade in a similar way to nature’s waste.

How does it work?
In the presence of oxygen, the prodegradant additive breaks the molecular chains in the polymer, and at the end of its useful life the product will degrade and biodegrade, that is it will be consumed by bacteria and fungi, after the additive has reduced the molecular weight to a level which permits them access to the carbon and hydrogen.

6313817034415.sourceDescription:
Product Features:

 2 pieces of plush Christmas pillow covers, 18×18 inch square throw pillow, for Christmas home decoration. Features a three-dimensional embroidered cane candy + bow pattern, cute festive designs, suitable for farmhouse-style Christmas arrangements.
 High-quality polyester plush fabric, soft and fluffy, comfortable Christmas sofa pillow cover. Hidden zipper closure, simple and unified appearance, convenient for removing and replacing the pillow core.
 Bright and vibrant festive color scheme, eye-catching and impressive, suitable for decorating living rooms and bedrooms. Solid workmanship, neat stitching, not easy to unravel or deform after repeated washing.
 Versatile decorative cover, suitable for sofas, chairs, benches, porches, fireplace tables. High-quality Christmas gift, suitable as a gift for relatives and friends during the holiday move.


Product Specifications:

 Quantity: 2
 Material: Polyester
 Size: 45*45cm
 Color: Red


Packaging Contents:
Christmas decorations * 2

Note:

 This Christmas pillow set only includes the pillow covers and does not include the pillow core filling material.
 Due to the influence of shooting light and screen differences, there may be slight color differences in the cane candy pillow covers, which is normal.
 If you receive a pillow cover with wrinkles, you can smooth out the creases by leaving it to stand or using low-temperature ironing.
 Before placing an order, confirm the size of the pillow core. This product is suitable for 18-inch pillow cores.
 Not waterproof. It is only suitable for indoor use and should not be exposed to prolonged rain outdoors.
Package includes 2 pieces of Christmas candy cane throw pillow covers, size 18 × 18 inch (45 × 45 cm). Pillow inserts are NOT included, only cushion covers are provided.
Made of premium 100% polyester plush fabric, the surface is soft, cozy and skin-friendly. Features exquisite 3D embroidered candy cane and bow pattern, full of festive Christmas charm.
Hidden zipper design for easy insertion and removal of pillow inserts. The zipper runs smoothly and does not scratch your hands or damage the pillow. Neat stitching ensures long-time use.
Perfect decorative cushion covers for sofa, couch, bed, living room, farmhouse, fireplace, window seat. Great for Christmas party, winter holiday, new year home decoration.
Easy to maintain, hand wash or gentle machine wash available. This classic red candy cane pillow cover is also a wonderful holiday gift for family and friends.

6313817035115.sourceDescription:
Product Features:

 Two sizes are available: Model A is 79×25CM, Model B is 135×30CM. It features a bright red plush and illuminated Christmas bow.
 It is equipped with built-in LED lights, powered by batteries, with an independent switch for easy operation. The internal shaping wire allows for free bending and adjustment of the bow shape.
 The soft plush fabric has a rich texture, in classic festive red, and is eye-catching and visually appealing. The lightweight design makes it convenient to hang on doors, Christmas trees, wreaths, windows, fireplaces, etc.
 It is suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor settings, ideal for Christmas and winter holiday decorations. It is suitable for Christmas parties, family gatherings, and as a background for holiday photos. It can be given as a Christmas gift
 to friends and relatives, or as a decoration for holiday enthusiasts.


Product Specifications:

 Quantity: 1 piece
 Color: Red
 Material: Flannel
 Size: 79×25CM / 135×30CM


Packaging Contents:
Christmas decorations*1

Note:

 The bowknot is powered by batteries. The packaging does not contain batteries.
 It is only suitable for outdoor environments with coverings. It is not waterproof. Do not directly get wet by rain or snow.
 Do not pull the LED light strings forcefully to avoid damage to the wiring.
 Gently wipe the surface with a dry cloth. Do not wash with water.
 There may be slight color differences on the screens of different devices. This is a normal phenomenon.
 Please confirm the style, size and color before placing the order.
This lighted flocked Christmas bow comes with built-in LED lights, available in two sizes: 79×25CM (Style A) and 135×30CM (Style B). The bright red flocked surface looks luxurious, and the glowing lights bring warm festive sparkle to your holiday scene.
Battery powered design, easy to operate with on/off switch. No complicated wiring required, you can place or hang it anywhere conveniently. The built-in wire inside the bow allows you to adjust the shape freely.
Perfect for multiple Christmas decoration scenarios. Hang it on front door, Christmas tree, wreath, porch, window, mantel, wall and gate. It is a standout decor for Christmas party, winter holiday and family celebration.
Premium flocked material, well-made and durable. The bow holds its shape nicely and will not deform easily. Lightweight for hanging, suitable for both indoor and covered outdoor decoration.
It is a fantastic holiday decoration and gift choice. This glowing red bow can create a strong Christmas atmosphere, also works as a wonderful backdrop prop for holiday photos.

0086879830115.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree & Holiday Decor: Complements traditional glass baubles, lights, and garlands on Christmas trees, fireplaces, mantelpieces, stair railings, and windows.

Handmade Gift Toppers & Keepsakes: Attach finished wooden diamond art pendants to holiday present packages, secret Santa gifts, or stocking stuffers for a personalized touch.

Winter Crafting & Relaxation: Ideal stress-relief creative activity during the winter season and holiday gatherings.

PACKAGE CONTENT

6 x Christmas Wooden Ornament Base Plates

EASY DIY STEPS

Open the package and check all tools and drill gems.

Match the symbol codes on the wooden ornament plate with the corresponding diamond color bags.

Apply a small amount of wax mud into the tip of the drill pen.

Pick up each resin gem using the pen and press it onto its matching symbol on the wooden plate.

Thread the included hanging cord through the top hole and hang your handmade wooden Christmas ornament.
Bring holiday cheer to your home with this 6-piece 5D DIY Christmas diamond painting wooden ornament kit. Designed for adults, kids, and crafters, this complete diamond art kit combines natural wood craftsmanship with multi-faceted resin rhinestones and sparkling gems to create charming handmade decorations for your Christmas tree.
Whether you are looking for a relaxing winter craft activity, a fun family DIY project, or unique holiday home accents, these double-sided wooden hanging pendants add warmth, shine, and festive charm to any space.
Natural Wooden Base: Crafted from durable, lightweight natural wood with smooth edges and vibrant printed holiday patterns on both sides.
3D & 5D Multi-Faceted Sparkle: Includes special-shaped resin rhinestones and sparkling gems that capture and reflect light from every angle.
Complete All-In-One Craft Kit: Comes with everything needed to start crafting immediately—6 wooden ornament bases, drill pen, sorting tray, sticky wax mud, hanging cords, and pre-sorted colored resin diamonds.
Pre-Drilled & Ready to Hang: Each wooden ornament features a pre-drilled top hole and includes natural jute twine/ribbons for easy hanging on Christmas trees, wreaths, and window hooks.
Relaxing & Beginner Friendly: Simple follow-by-number design makes this kit ideal for beginners, experienced crafters, family bonding time, and seasonal DIY projects.

5096042277215.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - 60 warm white LEDs and snowy pine for doors and walls - Green, white and red, 60 cm
5096042277215.sourceDescription:
A 60 cm ring of snow-dusted greenery holds cones, red berries and 60 warm white LEDs. The 15 cm depth gives a substantial profile. Select one of eight lighting modes and use the timer for a regular evening display.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Choose the start of the lighting period with the room's usual evening routine in mind. It is worth checking the controls while the wreath is still within reach, before moving it to its final position.

The pale tips give the arrangement its own highlights in daylight. Against dark paint the snowy edge is easy to follow, while a lighter background draws attention to the darker details tucked further into the design. Try the different effects once the room is lit as it normally will be at Christmas. A quieter setting often suits a dining area, while a changing effect can draw attention to a display at an entrance.

Small red berries show especially clearly against a simple backdrop. If you want to tie the wreath into a larger Christmas scheme, repeat their red in a nearby ornament and let the foliage provide the quieter colour. When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side.

Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position.

When packing away a lit decoration, support the body of the wreath and give the lighting components their own space.
60 warm white LEDs illuminate the snowy pine wreath with eight selectable lighting modes for versatile festive display.
Built-in timer allows you to schedule regular evening illumination, ensuring a consistent and effortless holiday atmosphere.
Measuring 60 cm in diameter with a substantial 15 cm depth, this wreath offers a rich, textured profile for doors or walls.
Decorated with realistic cones, red berries and snow-dusted greenery, creating a traditional and inviting Christmas aesthetic.

5096042275815.baseName: LED Christmas wreath - Illuminated Christmas decoration - Warm white LEDs and pine cones for a hallway or mantel - 40 x 40 cm
5096042275815.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Illuminated Christmas decoration - Warm white LEDs and pine cones for a hallway or mantel - 40 x 40 cm
5096042275815.sourceDescription:
Warm white LEDs run between red berries and pine cones. Their light catches the snowy finish of the branches, adding depth to the greenery. The battery supply means there is no mains lead to bring across the doorway. The decoration measures 40 x 40 cm.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. The pale tips give the arrangement its own highlights in daylight. Against dark paint the snowy edge is easy to follow, while a lighter background draws attention to the darker details tucked further into the design.

Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position. Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season.

Small red berries show especially clearly against a simple backdrop. If you want to tie the wreath into a larger Christmas scheme, repeat their red in a nearby ornament and let the foliage provide the quieter colour. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct.
Battery-powered operation eliminates the need for a mains lead, allowing safe placement near doorways without trailing cables.
Features warm white LEDs nestled among red berries and pine cones to create a traditional festive atmosphere with snowy branch accents.
Compact 40 x 40 cm size makes it ideal for hanging on hallways or displaying on mantels without overwhelming the space.
Versatile design provides decorative texture in daylight and illuminates the outline when lights are switched on at dusk.
Comes with 20x Edge Protectors

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.
